options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: include_recent
options.description: Whether to include recently completed jobs in the response.

options.name: include_summary
options.description: Whether to include job summary statistics in the response.

options.name: job_id
options.description: The ID of a specific job to retrieve. When specified, other filter options are ignored.

options.name: job_type
options.description: Filter jobs by their type. This is a client-side filter applied after retrieving jobs from the API. Multiple types can be specified.

options.name: limit
options.description: The maximum number of jobs to return.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: sort
options.description: The field to sort results by.

options.name: state
options.description: Filter jobs by their current state. Multiple states can be specified to match any of the given states.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
